raw_text: Has anyone else seen these AI news anchor channels spreading anti-India content? The synthetic anchors look like HeyGen avatars - you can tell from the slightly unnatural eye movements and the way the head tilts at regular intervals. The content is pure fabrication about India's economy collapsing and states seceding. Some of these channels have been running for months accumulating subscribers before switching to propaganda content. Clever but detectable.
